units: <cite ref="Shabbat 150a:2">Sabb. 150ᵃ</cite> <he>רכב … וקשר ת׳ ראשו</he> he (Nebuchadnezzar) rode on a male lion, and tied a snake around his head.
<cite ref="Niddah 22b:53">Nidd. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>דמות ת׳</he> an abortion in the shape of a monster; a. e.—Pl. <he>תּנִּינִים</he>, <he>תַּנִּינִין</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 148:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLVIII</cite> <he>ומי … אלו הת׳</he> who are the largest (inhabitants of the earth)? The monsters; a. e.
